brief:
Israel has set a final deadline for the closure of the British consulate in Jerusalem, the Ma'an news agency reported. The demand represents a significant escalation in longstanding diplomatic tensions between Israel and Britain over the mission's status and operations in the contested city.

The consulate has functioned as a point of friction in Israeli-Palestinian politics for years. Israel has consistently asserted full sovereignty over Jerusalem and contested the legal basis for foreign diplomatic presences operating independently within the city. Britain has maintained the consulate as a representation of its interests and those of British nationals in the region.

The specific date of the deadline and Israel's formal justification for the closure order were not immediately disclosed. The move comes amid broader disputes over Jerusalem's status and international recognition of Israeli authority over the city.
title: Israel sets final deadline to close British consulate in Jerusalem
